svg.title: Two views of the same line fit
svg.desc: The upper panel (a) shows the data points (0, 1), (1, 2), and (2, 2), the fitted line y-hat = 7/6 + t/2, and vertical residuals. The lower panel (b) shows the data vector y, its projection y-hat onto the column space of X, and the perpendicular residual r = y - y-hat.
